description:
CRUX, ATOMIC. For Typed callables, stop boxing the apply and dispatch straight to the body. Three changes that are a matched set and must land together (repr and dispatch must agree).

DE-RISKED SCOPE -- what does NOT change: the closure VALUE stays a heap pointer (publication seams box published_value_lane correctly, typed or boxed). The result path is ALREADY RawInt -- ReturnDelivery (body) and ReturnContinuation (the {:cont,int} continuation) are both codegen_repr_for_lane; the {:cont,int} tuple field is RawInt. The body ABI (typed_args, self, cont) is unchanged. So none of those move.

WHAT MOVES (all three, atomically, gated on CallConvention=Typed):
1. CallableBoundary seam (derive_codegen_seam_facts ~1025): drop the boxed_first_class override for Typed -> the apply's arg/return lanes become RawInt (type-driven), matching the body. This alone makes the codegen body==boundary check pass; fault 4 dissolves at the source.
2. Construction (collect_static_closure_targets / MakeClosure): a Typed closure's code slot = the BODY entry (fn_ids[body_sid], already computed and discarded as _body_sid), not the boxed wrapper. Key the static closure by (function, capture_count, convention) so a function used at both conventions gets distinct closures.
3. Dispatch (emit_call_closure indirect path): split on convention -- Typed builds a typed signature (raw args, self, cont)->raw ret and call_indirects the body pointer read from the closure; Boxed keeps the all-ValueRef path. This is LITERALLY the boxed wrapper's body-call (return_call body, [args, self, cont]) issued from the apply site minus the unboxing -- proven correct by the wrapper's existence. self is the closure pointer (unused by a zero-capture body). The single-lit direct fast path stays (Typed convention with known identity, by-name).

NO SHIMS: no wrapper is minted for Typed callables; the body is called at its native ABI.

OPEN (resolve here): a Typed callable needs a structure to carry (body code ptr, convention reprs) for construction+dispatch -- decide whether that is a convention-tagged 'callable entry' or the existing boundary fact stripped of its boxed parts. Pick the one that lets Boxed and Typed share the resolution machinery without a parallel ledger.

CHECK: opaque_fn_value_join + 00231 build AND run with correct reduced output; reducer.() dispatches typed-indirect (telemetry); add_a body return repr == RawInt == boundary repr; NO per-step heap allocation (Process.heap_alloc_stats oracle, already sampled by the fixture). Full lib + matrix green, zero warnings; destructor/provider-callback/escaped-lambda/single-ref/lambda/range reduce tests unmoved.
title: Honor the calling convention: typed construction, lane reprs, and dispatch (atomic)
